one_sentence_story: A source artifact sends one luminous trace through a transparent Context Capsule, where a torus family resolves into a cusp hexagonal fibre before landing as a visibly provisional S6 paper claim beside a World trace receipt.

beats.action: Reveal a single warm source artifact on the left platform; its only crisp label is SOURCE ARTIFACT.
beats.camera: Locked wide 16:9 frame; slow 4 percent push-in toward the document.
beats.causal_move: The source becomes the sole origin of the later trace.
beats.caption: Start with the thing that can be pointed to.

beats.action: Pull one amber filament from the artifact and animate it across the broken hexagonal ground toward center; no extra dashboard elements appear.
beats.camera: Keep the source and filament in the same frame so origin and direction remain legible.
beats.causal_move: The trace is visibly emitted by the source rather than appearing as decoration.
beats.caption: A trace carries provenance forward.

beats.action: The filament enters a glass prism labeled CONTEXT CAPSULE; inside, it brightens and becomes a cyan line without changing its endpoint.
beats.camera: Rack focus from the source to the capsule; preserve a thin amber segment behind the glass as continuity evidence.
beats.causal_move: Context changes the trace representation, not its source identity.
beats.caption: Context transforms the signal without erasing its origin.

beats.action: Inside the capsule, one torus grows into a family of three concentric toroidal loops; a single hexagonal cusp fibre branches from their shared point and exits right.
beats.camera: Orbit 12 degrees around the capsule, then stop when the cusp aligns with the exit path.
beats.causal_move: The family-to-cusp transition is the one geometric move that produces the outgoing claim path.
beats.caption: A family of forms narrows to one testable cusp.

beats.action: The cyan cusp fibre lands on a cool receipt sheet labeled WORLD TRACE RECEIPT; above it, a separate plaque reads S6 PAPER CLAIM and below it NEEDS TRACE.
beats.camera: Settle into a balanced wide shot with source at left, capsule center, receipt at right; fade all glow except the receipt edge.
beats.causal_move: The claim is presented as a paper claim and remains visibly conditional on the world trace receipt.
beats.caption: The paper claim closes only when a world trace can be checked.

caption_script.text: Start with the thing that can be pointed to.
Context transforms the signal without erasing its origin.
A family of forms narrows to one testable cusp.
The S6 paper claim closes only when a world trace can be checked.

construction: Create all static platforms and labels before animation; use explicit coordinates in scene units.
Draw the evidence stream as one cubic Bezier path and reveal it with Create, then transform only its stroke color at the capsule boundary.
Build the capsule from a translucent Rectangle, four low-opacity edge lines, and one inner Diamond; no image textures.
Construct torus family with ParametricFunction at radii 0.42, 0.58, 0.74 and fixed 96-sample resolution; construct cusp fibre from six straight hexagon edges plus one outgoing Line.
Render receipt sheet and claim plaque with crisp Text objects using a bundled sans font; never synthesize pseudo-text.
Use Succession with durations [2.0, 2.0, 2.5, 2.5, 3.0], then hold the final frame for 0.5 seconds.
manim_plan.verification_overlay: Optional debug-only coordinate grid is disabled in the public render; final frame must retain the three readable labels exactly.

falsifier: The concept is falsified if the rendered sequence cannot point from the source artifact to a resolvable World snapshot or event receipt, if the cusp appears without the torus-family transition, or if viewers read S6 PAPER CLAIM as an established consensus fact rather than a conditional paper claim.
evidence_boundary: The supplied image is visual grammar only. No ImageGen output is evidence; the final receipt must be populated from a real source pointer and World snapshot or event at render time.

receipts.worker_id_measurement: Card text states Worker id 37; output filename is worker-37.json.
